# Load Libraries
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rsample)

set.seed(123)

# Predictor names
raw_vars <- c(
  "B02", "B03", "B04", "B05", "B06",
  "B07", "B08", "B11", "B12"
)

vi_vars <- c(
  "NDVI", "GNDVI", "SAVI", "NDRE", "NDMI",
  "EVI", "BSI", "CIrededge", "MSI"
)

ilr_vars <- paste0("ILR", 1:8)

# Common complete-case dataset for fair predictor comparisons
data_ML <- final_data_ilr %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .row_id, year, Yield_avg,
    all_of(raw_vars),
    all_of(vi_vars),
    all_of(ilr_vars)
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024) %>%
  drop_na()

# 1. Development data: 2019–2023
development_common <- data_ML %>%
  filter(year %in% 2019:2023)

# 2. Independent temporal validation: 2024
validation_common <- data_ML %>%
  filter(year == 2024)

# 3. Split development data once:
#    80% training and 20% internal testing
#    Stratify by year to represent each historical year in both sets
split_common <- initial_split(
  development_common,
  prop = 0.80,
  strata = year
)

train_common <- training(split_common)
test_common  <- testing(split_common)

# Raw Sentinel-2 bands
train_raw <- train_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(raw_vars))

test_raw <- test_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(raw_vars))

validation_raw <- validation_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(raw_vars))

# Vegetation indices
train_vi <- train_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(vi_vars))

test_vi <- test_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(vi_vars))

validation_vi <- validation_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(vi_vars))

# ILR spectral balances
train_ilr <- train_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(ilr_vars))

test_ilr <- test_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(ilr_vars))

validation_ilr <- validation_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(ilr_vars))

# Check sample sizes and year distributions
split_summary <- bind_rows(
  train_common %>% mutate(dataset = "Training"),
  test_common %>% mutate(dataset = "Internal testing"),
  validation_common %>% mutate(dataset = "2024 validation")
) %>%
  count(dataset, year, name = "n")

print(split_summary)

# Confirm that datasets do not overlap
stopifnot(
  nrow(train_common) > 0,
  nrow(test_common) > 0,
  nrow(validation_common) > 0,
  length(intersect(train_common$.row_id,
                   test_common$.row_id)) == 0,
  length(intersect(development_common$.row_id,
                   validation_common$.row_id)) == 0
)
```
